resources.string: A retro, Nokia-style space shooter that plays itself on your home screen. Tap empty space to fire a missile.
A self-playing tribute to the classic monochrome phone shooter: auto-piloted ship, alien waves, bosses, a scrolling landscape and that green LCD glow.
Tip: tap an empty spot on your home screen to steer the ship there and launch a missile.
This device has no live wallpaper picker.
